home.title: Home
home.description: This is the PeoplePlatform home. The employee directory is the next thing to land here.

error.title: Application Error
error.footer: If the problem persists, please contact support or try refreshing the page.

employees.title: All Employees
employees.lead: Everyone in the company. Every request resolves what you're allowed to see.
employees.exactMatchHint: Filters are exact matches — type a full value, not a fragment.
employees.footerCount_one: {{count}} employee · sorted by last name, first name
employees.footerCount_other: {{count}} employees · sorted by last name, first name

empty.title: No employees match these filters
empty.body: Adjust or clear the filters to see more people.

emptyUnfiltered.title: No employees yet
emptyUnfiltered.body: Nobody has been imported into the platform. Import the seeded population to get started.

badRequest.title: That filter value isn't valid
badRequest.body: One of the filters isn't a valid value — adjust it and apply again.

error.title: Couldn't load the employee directory
error.body: The request failed. Check your connection and try again.

forbidden.title: You don't have access to the employee directory
forbidden.body: The directory is available to HR administrators only.

import.title: Import population
import.lead: Upload the seeded population export to load everyone into the platform. Good rows are created or updated; problem rows are skipped and listed in the summary.
import.expectedFileHint: A semicolon-delimited export from the timetracker (docs/Accounts_template.csv is the sample). The file is uploaded as-is — no parsing or column mapping happens here.
import.csvHint: That file doesn't end in .csv — upload it anyway if it's the timetracker export; the server checks the contents.
import.emptyFileHint: That file is empty. Choose the populated timetracker export.
import.permissionNotice: You don't have permission to import the population. This is available to HR administrators only.

fileError.fallback: The file was rejected. Check that it's the semicolon-delimited timetracker export and try again.

import.serverError: The import didn't complete. Nothing was imported — try again.
import.serverErrorTooLarge: That file is too large. Nothing was imported.

confirm.title: Import from {{name}}?
confirm.body: This creates and updates employee records in bulk. Existing employees matched by work email will be updated.

result.descriptionPartial: Skipped rows were not imported. Everything else was applied — review the skipped rows below.

unavailable.title: This profile isn't available
unavailable.body: You may not have access to it, or it no longer exists.

error.title: Couldn't load this profile
error.body: The request failed. Check your connection and try again.

photoError.type: Choose a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image.
photoError.size: That image is larger than 5 MB.
photoError.upload: Couldn't upload the photo. Try again.
photoError.storage: Photo storage is temporarily unavailable — try again.

error.emailConflict: That work email is already in use.
error.birthdayPair: Set both the birth day and month, or clear both.
error.birthdayCleared: Birthday can't be cleared here — leave the existing value.
error.permission: Your access to this profile changed — reload the page.
error.network: Couldn't reach the server. Try again.
error.generic: Couldn't save your changes. Check the fields and try again.

timeline.title: Career timeline
timeline.forbidden: Not available at your access level

deleteError.permission: That event is already gone, or your access changed — refresh the list.
deleteError.transient: Couldn't delete that event. Try again.

dialog.title: Add a timeline event
dialog.description: Events can't be edited. To fix one, delete it and add a new one.

error.detailsObject: Details must be a JSON object.
error.permission: Your access to this timeline changed — reload the page.
error.network: Couldn't reach the server. Try again.
error.generic: Couldn't add the event. Check the fields and try again.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this event?
deleteDialog.description: This removes the event from the timeline. You can re-add it later.

organisation.lead: Reporting line and People Partner for this employee, plus the access-change history. Only the actions the platform can perform today are shown here.
organisation.subjectFallback: Identity details aren't visible to you.
organisation.permissionNotice: You don't have permission to change organisational relationships.

notFound.title: Employee not found
notFound.body: There's no employee at this address, or it was removed.

derived.unavailable: Current value not available — the change history isn't visible to you.
derived.none: None recorded in the change history.

picker.filterLabel: Filter loaded people by name or email
picker.forbidden: Directory access is required to choose a person.
picker.error: Couldn't load the people directory. Try again.
picker.truncated: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} people. Narrow by exact first name, last name or work email.

manager.title: Manager
manager.hint: Assigning, reassigning and removing the reporting-line manager are available when the current relationship is visible to you.
manager.derivedHintNote: Reassigning or removing needs the authoritative relationships read, which isn't visible to you — only a fresh assignment is available.
manager.pickerDescription: Choose the person this employee reports to.
manager.reassignPickerDescription: Choose the new person this employee reports to. The current manager is removed first.

removeDialog.title: Remove the manager?
removeDialog.description: This clears the reporting-line manager for this employee.

error.self: An employee can't be their own manager.
error.alreadyAssigned: This employee already has a manager — reload the screen to reassign.
error.targetDeparting: That person has a scheduled departure and can't take on reports.
error.partialFailure: The previous manager was removed, but assigning {{name}} failed. Retry to finish.
error.noneToRemove: There is no manager to remove.
error.network: Couldn't reach the server. Try again.
error.generic: Couldn't assign the manager. Try again.

peoplePartner.title: People Partner
peoplePartner.removedNow: None — the People Partner was removed.
peoplePartner.pickerDescription: Choose this employee's People Partner. Assigning replaces any current one.

replaceDialog.title: Replace the current People Partner?
replaceDialog.description: This replaces the current People Partner with {{name}}.

removeDialog.title: Remove the People Partner?
removeDialog.description: This clears the People Partner for this employee.

error.self: An employee can't be their own People Partner.
error.inactiveTarget: That person isn't an active employee.
error.targetDeparting: That person has a scheduled departure and can't be assigned.
error.staleToken: The People Partner changed since this screen loaded. Refresh and try again.
error.noneToRemove: There is no People Partner to remove.
error.network: Couldn't reach the server. Try again.
error.generic: Couldn't update the People Partner. Try again.

journal.title: Access journal
journal.caption: Organisational access changes for this employee, newest first.

forbidden.title: The access history isn't visible to you
forbidden.body: The access history is visible only to this person's current manager or People Partner.

error.title: Couldn't load the access journal
error.body: The request failed. Check your connection and try again.

departure.subjectFallback: Identity details aren't visible to you.
departure.lead: Record this employee's departure: an effective date and a reason. If they still hold responsibilities, you'll reassign those first.
departure.permissionNotice: You don't have permission to record a departure for this employee.

confirm.title: Record this departure?
confirm.body: This records a departure for {{name}}, effective {{date}}. It can't be undone here.

form.title: Record a departure
form.description: The departure is applied automatically at the start of the effective date.

error.dateNotFuture: The effective date must be in the future.
error.dateRejected: The server rejected that effective date. Pick a later date.
error.alreadyScheduled: This employee already has a scheduled departure.
error.keyMismatch: The form changed since the last attempt — reload the page and resubmit.
error.badRequest: Couldn't record the departure. Check the fields and try again.
error.generic: Couldn't record the departure. Try again.
error.noId: The departure was recorded but its reference is missing. Reload the page to see its status.
error.network: Couldn't reach the server. Try again.

blockers.title: Responsibilities are blocking this departure
blockers.description: Reassign these before the departure can be recorded.
blockers.reparentToDefaultManager: Re-parent everything to this employee's manager
blockers.pickerDescription: Every blocking responsibility moves to this person.
blockers.cleared: Blockers cleared — record the departure now.
blockers.externalRemaining_one: {{count}} external (timetracker) blocker remains — resolve it in the source system.
blockers.externalRemaining_other: {{count}} external (timetracker) blockers remain — resolve them in the source system.

error.selfTarget: The re-parent target can't be the departing employee.
error.inactiveTarget: That person isn't an active employee.
error.versionStale: The situation changed — the blockers below have been reloaded. Review them and re-parent again.
error.stillBlocked: Some blockers are still present — review the list and re-parent again.
error.alreadyScheduled: This employee already has a scheduled departure.
error.network: Couldn't reach the server. Try again.

status.title: Scheduled departure
status.retryAdvisory: This departure is still retrying. If it doesn't apply soon, it may need attention.

applied.body: This employee's departure has been applied. There's nothing more to do here.

retry.notRetryable: This departure can no longer be retried — its state just changed.
retry.forbidden: You no longer have permission to retry this departure.
retry.gone: This departure is no longer available.
retry.failed: Couldn't request a retry. Try again.

gone.title: This departure is no longer available
gone.body: It may have been removed. Start again from the record form.

forbidden.title: You can't view this departure
forbidden.body: Recording and viewing a departure needs the departure capability, which you don't hold.

error.title: Couldn't load the departure status
error.body: The request failed. Check your connection and try again.

login.title: Sign in to PeoplePlatform
login.lead: We'll email you a single-use link — no password needed.
login.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
login.checkInboxBody: If that address matches an account, a sign-in link is on its way. The link expires shortly.

consume.errorTitle: This sign-in link is invalid or has expired
consume.errorBody: Request a fresh link and try again.

dashboards.lead: Operational overview scoped to your live reporting line direct reports.

peopleTable.title: Team Roster
peopleTable.subtitle: Reporting-line employee directory with live tier projection
